isolation_plan.motivation: The Step A smoke health gate fired on exactly ONE criterion: Pi_D per-class top-2 = car/airplane instead of the reference car/truck (gaze shift 0.2175, effective-steps std 0.886, frac_halted 0.213 all passed). The smoke ALREADY trained on 5K real + ~46K pseudo (the trainer's default pipeline, conf >= 0.65 on the 100K unlabeled set - the same composition as the v12 mixB / Sprint-1 reference runs that showed car/truck top-2), so the data-composition hypothesis is ruled out by construction: the driver must be an AIS-v1 sub-mechanism. Per the pre-registered rule, Step B stays gated until the driver is identified.

arms.label: isoA (halting OFF)
arms.ablation: entropy gate forced open (cont=1, v12 fixed-T belief accumulation); gaze update unchanged

arms.label: isoB (precision-recon OFF)
arms.ablation: w_recon stays FLAT (v12 recon weighting); the precision modulator no longer scales the reconstruction loss (trainer-side only)

isolation_plan.budget: ISO_EPOCHS=12 phase-1 (eps=0.031) epochs per arm, batch 16 / accum 16, same base checkpoint as the smoke; bounded ~4-5 GPU-h per arm on a T4
isolation_plan.decision_signal: final-epoch per-class Pi_D top-2 per arm vs the v12 reference pattern {car, truck}
isolation_plan.decision_rule: Attribute the smoke's Pi_D reordering (top-2 = car/airplane instead of reference car/truck) from the two bounded isolation arms (each ablates exactly ONE AIS sub-mechanism, everything else identical to the smoke): (1) if Isolation A (--no-ais-halting) restores car/truck in top-2, the entropy-gated halting / continuation-weighted belief accumulation is the primary driver; (2) if Isolation B (--no-ais-precision-recon) restores car/truck in top-2, the precision-modulated reconstruction weight is the primary driver; (3) if both restore, both contribute - the next isolation runs a combined-off arm; (4) if neither restores, the driver is the remaining shared AIS wiring (gaze-policy relocation / step_net / continuation x belief interplay) - the next isolation disables step_net, or a per-class error/gaze-coverage analysis runs on the smoke artifacts. In every branch Step B stays GATED until the ordering question is understood; the isolation verdict is recorded regardless of outcome (a null/ambiguous isolation is a valid, reportable result).
